issues.title: Custom domain not loading
issues.problem_statement: The customer's custom domain had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, although their funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link.

issues.title: www version of the domain showing an error
issues.problem_statement: After the main domain started loading, the www version of the customer's domain still showed an error page.

issues.title: Secure certificate padlock
issues.problem_statement: Support noted that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after the domain connects.

items.description: Support ruled out a browser cache problem, since the same error still showed in an incognito window.
evidence: Alright, so it is not a browser cache issue.

items.description: Support explained that an old A record for the domain, pointing to an old server address, was blocking the connection; the dashboard showed the domain as not connected.
evidence: That old record is blocking the connection.
I can see you have an A record for shop pointing to an old server address.

items.description: Customer deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record using the target value from their FlexiFunnels domain settings, following support's guidance; the dashboard then showed the domain as connected and the customer confirmed the domain loads.
evidence: I deleted the A record and added the CNAME. Saved.

items.description: Customer deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, following support's guidance, and confirmed that both the main domain and the www version load their funnel.
evidence: and the www version are loading our funnel now.

items.description: Support explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting.
evidence: the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting

items.description: Support will check that the secure certificate has been issued and will message the customer if it has not.
evidence: I'll check tomorrow morning that the certificate has been issued, and I'll message you if it hasn't.

skip_recommendation.explanation: Complete support call with clear outcomes.
